privacy: Your file is read in memory and never stored. For each strategy with 30 or more trades we keep only: a one-way fingerprint of its first 30 trades and of the whole list, the number of trades, the unit, our forecast for its next 30 trades, and the time. If you come back with 30 more trades, we also keep whether those trades ended up or down, to grade the forecast. Each check also adds one to a daily count (the way it came in and the kind of assistant, if any: public at /api/usage). No trades, no file, no IP address (the rate limiter holds addresses in memory for one minute).
